name: Fujian stationary rotating target - geometry baseline

plant.gimbal: center-lock angle command; optional finite response, camera follows actual virtual servo; calibrated virtual barrel
plant.hit_model: front-facing finite plate, projectile center crossing; no referee sensor model

provenance.rule_pdf: 2026年福建省大学生机器人大赛任务规则_V1.0 (1).pdf

rule_confirmed.distance: Appendix A p12: shooting area to target distance 3m; center-reference interpretation is provisional
rule_confirmed.motion: 1.1 p3 and 3.1 p7: center fixed, rotation about vertical Z
rule_confirmed.ammo_hp_damage: 17mm, 50 rounds, 10 damage; early PDF HP310 superseded by user's field clarification: HP300

prior_investigation.omega: configs/standard.yaml xuc_event_fixed_omega_rad_s: prior stable-run observed median, not official rule
prior_investigation.speed: configs/standard.yaml: prior optical gate record 21.8-22.2m/s, nominal22; not a new measurement
prior_investigation.geometry: 2026-10-24 diagnostic logs, whole_rotation_trusted samples: radius0 median .258/.260m, delta .017/.025m; height relative to gimbal about .03m, delta about0; estimates, not caliper measurements
prior_investigation.armor: production Solver uses 135mm width, 56mm lightbar length and +15deg pitch; prior hit-window height55mm; official active-hit dimensions unconfirmed
prior_investigation.fps: historical main-loop around50FPS; not camera hardware maximum or post-optimization live FPS
prior_investigation.processing_age: 8.36ms isolated detector benchmark only; total capture-to-command age remains unmeasured

assumptions.muzzle_delay: 330ms is the current predictor parameter, NOT measured command-to-muzzle time; plant baseline assumes it matches, sweep independently
assumptions.idealizations: default baseline has zero errors; stress distributions are explicit synthetic hypotheses, not measured hardware; no drag, misfeed or calibrated referee electronics; synthetic detections bypass YOLO
assumptions.direction_phase: rule TBD; cover both directions and four phases, not one officially confirmed direction/phase

provenance.user_field_clarification: HP300, damage10, ammo50: at least30 hits (60 percent of total budget). This newer direct instruction supersedes early PDF HP310. Evaluate full50 budget without HP feedback to controller.
